findings.summary: Fragment missing key on orders rows
findings.detail: filtered.map uses a bare <> fragment as the outermost element. React cannot assign a key to it, so every rendered order generates a console key warning. Fix: replace <> with <React.Fragment key={order.id}> and remove the key from the inner <tr>.

findings.summary: Cookie missing Secure and SameSite attributes
findings.detail: document.cookie sets addy_admin=true without Secure or SameSite=Lax. On any non-localhost HTTP deployment the cookie travels in cleartext, and the missing SameSite opens a CSRF vector. Add Secure; SameSite=Lax to the cookie string.
